<thought>Using the available functional group list, I will search the template catalog for retrosynthetic templates that break a C‑C double bond, which is characteristic of the Diels‑Alder cycloaddition. This should return candidate templates, after which I can verify which one matches the target molecule and retrieve its mapped reaction SMILES.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["C-C double bonds"],
    "limit": 10
}
</action_input>
